name: Meta-labeled funding-contrarian reversion (long spot)
rationale: META-LABELING on a NON-momentum primary — the existing meta-label specs (momentum, reversion-RSI) both gate PRICE-only primaries; none gate a FUNDING signal. Here the PRIMARY is deliberately permissive crowding-contrarian: enter long spot when funding is below a low floor (perp shorts crowded / uncrowded-long, a setup that historically precedes a squeeze up) — that decides only the SIDE. The SECONDARY regularized-logistic classifier decides ACT vs SKIP, trained expanding-window + point-in-time on which barrier (stop/take/time) each PAST funding-contrarian entry hit first, netted of cost, reading the orthogonal state at entry: funding_rate, perp_spot_basis, rsi, vol_realized, dvol. The secondary only SIZES/SKIPS, never flips direction. Economic bet: the funding-contrarian setup has a real but regime-dependent edge (it works when basis/vol confirm the squeeze, fails in a genuine downtrend), and a secondary that reads those orthogonal confirmers can prune the failures the bare funding floor cannot. Distinct from metalabel-momentum (momentum primary), metalabel-reversion (RSI primary), and funding-reset-reversion (no secondary model at all). HONEST PRIOR: meta-labeling can only amplify an edge the primary already has; if the bare funding-contrarian primary has no edge net of fees, this is a powered FAIL — the spec runs that test cleanly. Disconfirmer 1: compare to the bare primary (no meta-label) — the secondary must ADD deflated Sharpe, not just cut trades. Disconfirmer 2: the secondary must beat a random skip of the same trade fraction. tier0 funding_rate primary + orthogonal meta features (incl. tier0 dvol/basis), fresh prod data — low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: the secondary model green-lights a funding-contrarian long in a regime where the squeeze-reversion has historically paid
